source_snapshot.criteria: Link can successfully execute D3 transitions without error
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 60 attended and 1440 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual but omits D3hot/D3cold, power-resource and functional-recovery semantics.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held Pending for D3 state/scope, quiesce/wake, latency, evidence, restoration and recovery.

old_problem: D3hot and D3cold have materially different power, wake and re-enumeration behavior. A final visible link cannot prove actual D-state entry, safe consumer quiesce, wake latency, driver/function recovery, or absence of transient errors across 10,000 cycles.
disposition_reason: The source fixes D3 entry/exit, exact count and no-error objective. The D3 variant, controlling function/resource topology, quiesce, wake, latency, restoration, ledger and recovery are runtime Project Configuration. Review Pending is removed without guessing D3cold or treating link retrain as device-power coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2120, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2121 / Wistron-HW-00472-V002 / a2ad2978391bc10d was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Preserve exactly 10,000 device D3 transitions; D3hot cannot be credited as D3cold and neither L1 nor retrain is equivalent.
Bind the exact PCI function, endpoint/link and shared power-resource topology, supported D3 target, quiesce requirements, entry proof, wake source, functional restoration and latency ceiling.
For each cycle record D-state/resource entry, wake, enumeration/link, driver bind and function readiness, latency, plus new AER/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power deltas before the next cycle.
A final enumerated endpoint, forced rebind, setup, incomplete wake or retry does not count; compressed evidence must retain gap and first-fault visibility.
Stop on failed entry/wake, lost/unhealthy function, downtrained link, driver failure, shared-device impact, disqualifying error/reset, evidence gap or safety anomaly.
Preserve first fault, restore policy only by signed method, never remove shared power blindly or retry automatically.
No D-state or power-resource change, LTSSM/NVQual, driver rebind, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove exactly 10,000 approved D3 entries and exits for the mapped PCI function, including intended power state/resource condition, bounded wake and complete link/driver/function restoration without disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual D3 configuration compatible with firmware and driver
Approved D3hot or D3cold target, quiesce, entry proof, wake, latency, enumeration/link/driver/function rules
10,000-entry durable power-state ledger with first-fault interlock and policy-restoration audit
Dedicated idle SUT, out-of-band console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve D-state/policy/topology/link/driver/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only the pinned D3 entry/exit method for entries 1..10000. Durably record intended D-state/resource condition, wake, latency, enumeration/link, driver/function readiness and error/health deltas before enabling the next cycle. Stop on first anomaly or gap; do not force power, rebind or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 10,000 entries prove the approved D3 state/resource condition and wake within deadline to healthy enumeration, required link, bound driver and functional endpoint, with no disqualifying new errors and final policy/topology/health restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until D3 variant, function/power topology, quiesce/entry/wake/latency/restoration/error rules, ledger and recovery are approved. PASS requires 10,000 complete accepted cycles. FAIL on wrong state/resource, failed/late wake, lost/downtrained function/link, driver/function failure, shared impact, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; retries do not count.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until supported D3 target, function/power scope, quiesce, wake/restoration acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Never infer D3cold or remove a shared resource without mapped ownership and recovery.
Use an isolated idle SUT with all consumers quiesced, console and explicit 10,000-cycle authorization.
Commit each power/function result and stop without forced rebind or retry at first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval, tool/configuration, supported D3 state and full power/function topology
Gap-detecting ledger 1..10000 with state/resource entry, wake, restoration timestamps and disposition
Correlated PCI power/link/AER, driver/GPU function, kernel/BMC/thermal/power evidence
Tool restart, artifact-integrity and shared-resource audit
First-fault/recovery or clean restored policy/final function/link/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first wrong state/resource, failed/late wake, missing/unhealthy function, downtrain, driver failure, shared-device effect, disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap, inhibit later cycles and preserve the event. Restore only by signed out-of-band procedure; do not force rebind or retry and quarantine if health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require 10,000 D3 transitions; exact D3 variant and resource/wake details are project inputs.

blocked.reason: The review-layer method is complete; runtime remains gated on supported D3 semantics, topology, tooling, evidence and recovery.
